notes: Only ONE folded thickness is published for this model (11.08 mm) - no hinge-side/non-hinge-side split - so depth_at_hinge is null. Huawei publishes TWO masses, split by back finish: PU Version approx. 239 g, Glass Version approx. 241 g; the larger (241 g, Glass/羽砂 version) is recorded and both are quoted. The archived China spec page additionally lists a third SKU, 典藏版 (Collector's Edition) at approx. 242.5 g, which is not offered on the English page. LOCALE: consumer.huawei.com/en/phones/mate-x3/specs/ now returns HTTP 404 (the model is delisted from the global site), so the English primary used here is Huawei's Oman locale page, consumer.huawei.com/om/phones/mate-x3/specs/. Numbers were cross-checked against Huawei's own China spec page via web.archive.org snapshot 2024-04-19 - identical. The hinge/material citations come from Huawei's China product page via web.archive.org snapshot 2023-04-13. Chinese translations: "HUAWEI Mate X3 采用新一代双旋水滴铰链，兼顾轻薄与可靠。" = "HUAWEI Mate X3 adopts a new-generation dual-rotation water-drop hinge, balancing thinness and reliability." "配合高精度凸轮传动，不仅能实现稳定悬停" = "paired with high-precision cam transmission, it not only achieves stable hovering". "昆仑玻璃，耐用可靠 外屏采用昆仑玻璃" = "Kunlun Glass, durable and reliable - the exterior screen uses Kunlun Glass". "抗指纹羽砂玻璃，类钻晶体结构 ... 超薄素皮，自然纯粹纹理" = "anti-fingerprint Feather Sand glass with a diamond-like crystal structure ... ultra-thin vegan leather with a naturally pure texture". "长度" = length (the long axis, mapped to height). Huawei states the folded thickness excludes the camera module and the unfolded thickness excludes the screen border: "Folded thickness does not include the appearance of the camera module. Unfolded thickness does not include screen borders." Height 156.9 mm is published as one value for both states. materials.frame null: the China page names "超轻金刚铝与碳纤维等创新材料" ("innovative materials such as ultra-light diamond aluminium and carbon fibre") as structural materials but never ties them to the frame/middle frame. Display aspect ratios are not published - left null; PPI 426 is published but active_area_mm is left null because Huawei states the diagonals are standard-rectangle measurements with a slightly smaller actual viewing area. resolution_px recorded in Huawei's printed order (long axis first). microsd port = Huawei's proprietary NM card slot ("NM SD Card, up to 512 GB"), recorded under the nearest allowed kind. announced/released null: no manufacturer page carrying a launch date for this model was found; the March 2023 dates appear only on excluded secondary sources. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
